name: Standard IronMON
description: NFNF IronMON encoding of the core Standard IronMON rules. Verify wording and details against the official ruleset (ironmon.gg / IronMON community docs) before competitive use.
source: Community IronMON rules; NFNF encoding v1

rules.description: The run ends when your starter Pokémon faints.
Healing at a Pokémon Center is not allowed.
Only the starter may battle. A different Pokémon leading a battle is flagged for review (it may be a legitimate forced situation).
Loading a save state is not part of IronMON play.
The ROM was generated with the official IronMON randomizer settings for this game.
Battle/healing item usage follows the official Standard ruleset limits.
